subject.title: fix: discord exec approvals fails against local self-signed TLS gateway

question: Should OpenClaw accept the shared bootstrap TLS fingerprint propagation approach for approval/bootstrap clients once the open PR is reconciled, or require a narrower TLS trust design?
rationale: The remaining fix changes which GatewayClient paths receive certificate pins for WSS trust decisions, so maintainer security-boundary intent should be explicit before landing.

options.title: Accept shared bootstrap propagation after security review
options.body: Reconcile the open PR or a clean successor, preserve the documented local/remote/override semantics, and validate Gateway, ACP, MCP, and approval paths before merge.

options.title: Require a narrower approval-only fix
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask for a smaller operator approval fix if maintainers do not want shared bootstrap TLS selection yet.

options.title: Pause until gateway TLS policy is redesigned
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical bug while maintainers decide a broader TLS trust model for all bootstrap clients.

recommendation.title: Accept shared bootstrap propagation after security review
recommendation.body: Reconcile the open PR or a clean successor, preserve the documented local/remote/override semantics, and validate Gateway, ACP, MCP, and approval paths before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared operator approvals helper history points to steipete as the best available routing owner for the gateway approval helper boundary.
